name: claude-eyes
description: Menu-bar app: when you start speaking into the microphone, instantly screenshots your screen and sends it to Claude.

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Claude Eyes listens to your microphone only to detect when you start speaking.
extendInfo.NSScreenCaptureUsageDescription: Claude Eyes takes a screenshot when you start speaking so Claude can see your screen.
extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Claude Eyes pastes the screenshot into the Claude app.
